open_points.subject: A1
open_points.text: INV-01: after a scan, a placement, a repeated placement and a mark, the source folder holds the same files with the same bytes, modification times and modes (`test_no_operation_changes_the_source_folder`).
open_points.question: Must INV-01 also be shown for the health operation and for refused or failed variants of scan, placement and mark, since the invariant says “no operation”?
options: Test every operation and relevant refusal or failure path
Limit INV-01 explicitly to the four successful actions listed
open_points.default_guess: Test every operation and representative refusal or failure paths.

witness.initial: A source folder contains one photo; the service can answer health and can refuse a placement before completing it.
events: The test runs the successful scan, placement, repeated placement and mark listed in the Required tests item.
An implementation modifies a source-folder entry only during health or a refused placement.
outcomes: The named test passes although INV-01 is false for another operation path.
An implementation that never modifies the source folder also passes.
witness.observer: The owner or filesystem auditor sees the source-folder change.

open_points.subject: A1
open_points.text: INV-02: for content with no placement, an empty or absolute name, a name with an empty, `.` or `..` segment, an ignored name at any level, a folder, and a path through a symbolic link each fail with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure and add no file except the project lock, and a trace of every file the process opens while the delivery runs shows no opening of the named file, of a folder past the segment that fails or of a link's target (`test_a_name_a_scan_would_not_report_is_not_delivered`).
open_points.question: What must demonstrate INV-02 for the other failures in A3 rule 5 condition 1, including an absent last segment, a folder-opening failure, and unreadable metadata?
options: Add cases and open traces for every condition-1 failure class
Narrow INV-02 to the name, folder and symbolic-link cases listed
open_points.default_guess: Add representative cases for every condition-1 failure class and assert that no path beyond the failing segment is opened.

witness.initial: A requested path has a parent folder that exists but cannot be opened, or a final entry whose metadata cannot be read.
events: The delivery reaches A3 rule 5 condition 1.
One implementation attempts to open a path beyond the failing segment; another stops immediately.
outcomes: Both implementations can pass all cases named by the Required tests item.
Only the second implementation satisfies INV-02 for this history.
witness.observer: A filesystem trace or security monitor sees the extra open attempt.

open_points.subject: A3
open_points.text: INV-19: delivering content that has no placement under the name of a conflict copy fails with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure, adds no file except the project lock and changes no existing file (`test_a_syncthing_conflict_copy_is_neither_offered_nor_placed`). Placed content replays when only a conflict copy still holds it (`test_placed_content_replays_when_only_a_conflict_copy_still_holds_it`), and an ordinary file with the content of a conflict copy is delivered (`test_an_ordinary_file_is_placed_when_a_conflict_copy_has_the_same_content`).
open_points.question: Must the INV-19 test trace file access and show that a new placement never opens or reads the conflict copy, rather than showing only the answer and durable state?
options: Require an open/read trace proving the conflict copy is not read
Weaken INV-19 to require only refusal and unchanged durable state
open_points.default_guess: Require a trace proving that the conflict-copy file is never opened or read.

witness.initial: An unplaced conflict-copy file contains valid image bytes.
events: The caller requests delivery using the conflict-copy name.
One implementation reads and hashes the file before returning NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT; another rejects the ignored name before opening it.
outcomes: Both return the required failure and make the same durable changes described by the test.
Only the second satisfies “a new placement never reads a conflict copy.”
witness.observer: A filesystem trace or access-control monitor sees the read.

open_points.subject: A5
open_points.text: For an absent file, a file that cannot be opened, a file that is not UTF-8 or JSON, a file of another form and a record that breaks the form of rule 8, also when that record is unconfirmed or belongs to another project, scan, placement and mark each answer the FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE member of = models.RefusalCode and write nothing (`test_unreadable_connections_deliver_nothing`), and the service does not start (`test_the_service_does_not_start_with_an_unreadable_connection_record`).
open_points.question: Must the test also show that no source folder is scanned when the connections file is invalid, rather than only checking the refusal and absence of writes?
options: Trace source-folder access and require none for every invalid-connections case
Change INV-10 so it guarantees only refusal and no durable writes
open_points.default_guess: Trace source-folder access and require zero access before a valid confirmed connection is obtained.

witness.initial: The connections file is invalid but contains a recoverable-looking photo-folder path.
events: A scan request reaches the connection check.
One implementation inspects that photo folder before returning FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE; another validates the whole connections file first and never consults the folder.
outcomes: Both return FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE and write nothing as the Required tests item states.
Only the second satisfies “nothing is scanned” unless the file is valid and the connection confirmed.
witness.observer: A filesystem trace sees whether the untrusted source folder was consulted.

open_points.subject: A7
open_points.text: INV-13: a counting clock is read once by a mark and not at all by a scan, a delivery or the health answer (`test_only_the_mark_reads_the_clock`), and `marked_at` equals that reading (`test_a_marked_photo_is_reported_as_published`).
open_points.question: Which mark paths must demonstrate the clock-reading invariant: a new mark, a replay, a refusal before the specified point, and each refusal after it?
options: Test all timing branches required by A7 rule 2
Test only a successful new mark and weaken rule 2 accordingly
open_points.default_guess: Test a successful mark, a replay, at least one pre-reading refusal and every distinct post-reading refusal class.

witness.initial: A placement is already marked, and another request can also be refused before identifier validation completes.
events: The caller repeats the existing mark and then sends an invalid mark request.
One implementation reads the clock twice for the replay and once for the early refusal; another reads it once for the replay and zero times for the early refusal.
outcomes: Both can pass a test that exercises only one successful mark, scan, delivery and health.
Only the second follows A7 rule 2 and INV-13 on these paths.
witness.observer: The injected counting clock records different call counts.

open_points.subject: A11
open_points.text: A `photo_date` ending in `Z` or in an offset `+HH:MM` or `-HH:MM` is an old date. / a project holding only UTC dates passes
open_points.question: Does a UTC date ending in `Z` stop delivery as an old date, or is it one of the UTC dates that must pass?
options: A trailing `Z` is old and stops the project; only offsetless UTC values pass
A trailing `Z` is valid UTC and passes; only explicit numeric offsets are old
open_points.default_guess: Treat `Z` as old because normative rule 1 names it explicitly, and rewrite the test as “only offsetless UTC dates passes.”

witness.initial: The Portal staff photo list contains only `2026-11-20T10:00:00Z`.
events: The calling flow reads the project's staff photo list before placement.
outcomes: Normative rule 1 classifies the value as old, so the flow places and publishes nothing.
The Required tests phrase can classify it as a UTC date, so the project passes and delivery continues.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a repair warning or a delivered photo.

open_points.subject: A8
open_points.text: INV-14: a prepared image above the stored image limit fails with `too_large` and nothing is stored (`test_an_image_above_the_portal_read_limit_is_not_stored`).
open_points.rule: Член, названный одним значением, — нарушение: значение с точкой или дефисом не является именем ни одного члена, генератор пишет только имена (`AuditAction.EXPENSE_CREATE`), и валидатор отклоняет такую note (`note_enum_member_by_value`).
open_points.question: Name the TOO_LARGE member of = models.PlacementFailure, optionally followed by its value, instead of naming only `too_large`.
